name: rhythm-fox
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: SleepLens chronotype companion mascot.
Input image role: style reference only, SleepLens owl; create a different character.
Primary request: Create a friendly small fox as a companion to the SleepLens owl, representing a person's daily rhythm and preferred focus hours. Use the same rounded, simple flat illustration style and proportions. Fox has a warm muted apricot body, off-white cheek/chest shapes, charcoal eyes and nose, small deep-teal details, upright triangular ears and a large rounded curled tail with an off-white tip. One tiny pale-teal circular lens detail around its right eye subtly connects the brand family. Calm alert expression, softly open eyes, relaxed pose, suitable for adult users. It must be unmistakably a fox, not another owl.
Composition: single complete character centered on square genuine transparent canvas,10%clear margins,no background. Preserve small-icon readability.
Constraints: no words,numbers,medical symbols,clocks,productivity percentages,accessories,shadows or extra characters. No 3D or photorealism. This character is decorative and must not imply scientific diagnosis.
